title: Restore canonical deposit and payment application form entry
description: Restore the existing deposit-apply/payment-apply menus to the canonical api/finance/deposit-applies and api/finance/payment-applies modules, removing only the legacy dispatch precedence for these menus. The existing legacy stored-procedure mutation gate remains fail closed; do not map legacy Oid to canonical Id. FinanceDepositApply/FinancePaymentApply ApplyNo are Required with empty defaults although FinanceApplyControllers generates the authoritative numbers. Make blank-number genuine MVC requests reach the existing authorized business actions; maintain server-owned identity/status and current money/customer/source validation. Wire the existing explicit sales-order source selector, including nullable blank fields and explicit clearing, and preserve source freezes/active payment guards. Current business document page and basic-data drawer behavior must remain intact. Write full build/test output and TRX under .ai/logs/<task>/ with explicit --results-directory; never put generated artifacts in the repository root or stage them. Preserve all original failure logs and result files; if relocation is necessary verify exact targets stay inside the executor and copy/move completed artifacts into .ai/logs without deleting work or resetting attempts. Test API fixtures must use an ephemeral process-local cryptographic JWT key and genuine existing authentication, not production configuration or a missing-key fallback. Retain existing live identity/menu/customer-scope authority, transactions, source locks, controlled errors and audit. Reject before numbering or persistence, with zero header/detail/source/status mutations. No new permissions, schema, production access, external service or arbitrary SQL. Genuine SQL only on (localdb)\NEWERP_AutoAcceptance with Integrated Security and a fresh GUID-owned NEWERP_AUTOTEST database; reject wrong/existing targets and never drop/reset. Require safe Release with analyzers/warnings-as-errors, full units and relevant genuine SQL/browser tests; accurately record blockers and do not claim whole-stage acceptance.
acceptance_criteria: The two authorized application menus use canonical IDs/endpoints; blank-number HTTP create yields the server number and default state. Main-form save/reload/edit and explicit sales-order selection/clearing preserve authoritative customer/source identity, supported unlinked/manual entry and typed nullable fields without legacy remapping.

Valid submit/approve/cancel operations use existing live authority and transaction/source locks. Invalid money/currency/rate, stale source, ownership mismatch, missing permission or active downstream payment evidence rejects atomically with zero application/source/payment/status/number side effects and no permission expansion.

Rules/controller and genuine isolated SQL/HTTP tests cover omitted-number model binding, round trip, linked/manual forms, valid lifecycle and rejected zero writes/numbering; real browser proof must use actual authorized writes or accurately record its missing execution. Preserve source-picker/lifecycle regressions, safe Release/full units and all full log/TRX evidence.
implementation_evidence: bill-v2.js:41-42 still routes deposit-apply/payment-apply to blocked legacy families, while modules-finance.js:3-36 defines their canonical endpoints/selectors. Finance1.cs marks the ApplyNo properties Required with empty default; FinanceApplyControllers.Create assigns them via GenerateAsync (deposit line 146, payment line 482). ERP-380/381/390/391 govern source/state rules but do not close primary menu/model-binding entry.
